projects.title: Mini Redis C++ Server
projects.bodyText:
- A high-performance, in-memory key-value store built from scratch in **C++**.
- Designed an **O(1) LRU cache** using a combined hashmap and doubly-linked-list structure with bounded-capacity eviction.
- Built a raw **TCP server** (cross-platform: POSIX sockets / Winsock) supporting a custom text-based command protocol.
- Handles **concurrent multi-client connections** via a thread-per-connection model with **std::mutex** for thread safety.

projects.title: Backend Ledger System
projects.bodyText:
- A robust **backend banking system** using **Node.js**, **Express.js**, and **MongoDB** to securely manage financial records and user account balances.
- Engineered **REST APIs** to process banking transactions, deposits, and withdrawals with accurate data flow.
- Designed optimized database schemas with **Mongoose**, implementing strict validation and transaction handling to prevent race conditions.

projects.title: Zerodha Clone
projects.bodyText:
- A full-stack **clone of Zerodha** (India's largest stock broker) built with the **MERN stack**.
- Features responsive trading dashboard UI with real-time data visualization.
- Implements user authentication, portfolio management, and stock watchlist functionality.

projects.title: Teensy Flight Computer
projects.bodyText:
- Custom **flight avionics computer** built for Rocketry DTU's competition rockets.
- Handles real-time **sensor data acquisition** (IMU, barometer, GPS) and **telemetry transmission**.
- Earned an **"Excellent" grade** at the IN-SPACe & ISRO Rocketry Competition 2025.
- Developed alongside ground-station software for live mission monitoring.

projects.title: AI Stock Trend Predictor
projects.bodyText:
- A financial forecasting tool utilizing **LSTM Neural Networks** and **Streamlit** for interactive visualization.
- Features **real-time data ingestion** via `yfinance` and automated data preprocessing.
- Provides trend predictions with customizable time windows and technical indicators.

projects.title: Voice Feedback & Speech Engine
projects.bodyText:
- A **low-latency voice feedback** and speech-processing engine built in Python.
- Converts real-time audio input into structured text and dynamic speech responses.
- Uses Python audio libraries for efficient audio processing and NLP.
